seo.title: Capella Singapore Sentosa: 30-Acre Resort Review 2026
seo.description: 112-room Norman Foster resort on Sentosa with three pools and a 30-acre rainforest. Score 90/100, from $900/night.

content.verdict: Capella Singapore is the city's only true resort hotel — 30 acres of restored colonial-era Tanah Merah officers' quarters on a hilltop on Sentosa Island, woven into rainforest, with three cascading swimming pools and one of the most accomplished spas in Asia. Norman Foster's 2009 architecture takes the original 1880s British military buildings (the two Tanah Merah colonial blocks) and links them with a contemporary curved low-rise wing that wraps around the lawn and pools. The result is the polar opposite of Marina Bay's vertical glass — horizontal, lush, peacock-strewn (yes, peacocks roam the grounds), and palpably tropical. The G20 summit was held here in 2018 (Trump–Kim); the staff have seen it all. For honeymooners, Capella is the move when you want resort feel inside a city break — proper swimming pool days, jungle-walks past the rainforest, three pools (the spectacular split-level cascading lap pool with sea horizon, a separate family pool, and the Auriga Spa relaxation pool), and a 30-minute taxi back to Marina Bay when you want it. The accommodations split into three: the colonial wing rooms (Premier Garden, restored 19th-century officers' quarters), the contemporary wing (Premier Sea View facing the South China Sea), and the standalone villas (one-bedroom Garden Villas with private pool, the famous Sir Manor with three bedrooms). The honeymoon picks are the Premier Sea View room (the best $/sq ft) or the One-Bedroom Garden Villa with a private plunge pool (the splurge — and the only true private-pool option in Singapore). The food: Cassia for Cantonese, the Knolls for Mediterranean (the breakfast is genuinely outstanding), and the Bob's Bar — the rooftop bar of the colonial wing, with sea views and the best martini in Singapore. The Auriga Spa is the property's secret weapon — gender-segregated bath houses with herbal steam, vitality pools, sauna, then couples treatment rooms with their own private outdoor courtyard. Caveats: getting to Marina Bay is 30 minutes by taxi each way (or the Sentosa cable car, which is a slow but spectacular option); the beach is a 10-minute walk down — and it's Sentosa beach, urban not Maldivian; and the room rate jumps in the holidays. But for couples who want resort honeymoon feel with city-on-tap, Capella is the only correct answer in Singapore.
content.best_room: The Premier Sea View room (645 sq ft) in the contemporary wing is the value pick — proper sea horizon, large balcony, full Capella service. For the splurge, the One-Bedroom Garden Villa (1,948 sq ft) is the only private-plunge-pool accommodation in Singapore — a standalone walled garden, the pool, an outdoor rain shower, indoor bath, and a private butler. Sir Manor is the multi-bedroom destination villa for honeymoons with extended family.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Sentosa arrival and the cascading pools
itinerary_7_nights.description: Private transfer from Changi (35 min). Welcome champagne in the villa. Sunset at Bob's Bar (the rooftop, the martini). Dinner at Cassia.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Marina Bay city day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Cable car or taxi to Marina Bay. National Gallery morning. Lunch at Burnt Ends (1-Michelin Australian BBQ). Afternoon at the ArtScience Museum. Sunset cocktails at Spago atop Marina Bay Sands. Late dinner back at Capella in the Knolls.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Sentosa beach and rainforest day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Sleep late. Breakfast at the Knolls. Cascading pool morning. Lunch poolside. Afternoon walk through the Capella rainforest and down to Tanjong Beach Club. Auriga Spa couples treatment 5pm. Dinner in the villa.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Heritage Singapore day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Morning at Tiong Bahru and the Buddha Tooth Relic Temple. Lunch at Maxwell Food Centre (Tian Tian chicken rice). Afternoon at Raffles Long Bar for a Singapore Sling. Cable car back. Dinner at Cassia.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Lazy resort day
itinerary_7_nights.description: Long morning by the cascading pool. Lunch at Bob's Bar. Auriga Spa hammam ritual. Sunset on the villa terrace. Dinner at Odette (3-Michelin) — taxi 20 min.

itinerary_7_nights.title: Gardens by the Bay and Little India
itinerary_7_nights.description: Morning at the Cloud Forest dome. Lunch at Komala Vilas in Little India. Afternoon nap at Capella. Gardens by the Bay 8.45pm light show. Late seafood dinner at Long Beach Seafood (chilli crab).

itinerary_7_nights.title: Final morning and departure
itinerary_7_nights.description: Breakfast at the Knolls. Last morning at the pool. Private transfer to Changi (35 min — allow 4 hours for Jewel Changi).

caveats: 30 minutes by taxi to Marina Bay each way — factor in for evening reservations.
Beach is Sentosa public beach (10 min walk) — pleasant but not Maldivian.
Rates spike sharply for Chinese New Year, F1 weekend, and Christmas/NYE.

faqs.question: Good for honeymooners?
faqs.answer: The only true resort honeymoon hotel in Singapore — private pool villas, rainforest grounds, three swimming pools, and full city-on-tap via 30-minute taxi.

faqs.question: Best time to visit?
faqs.answer: February–April for dry season. July is the secret best month. Avoid November–January monsoon and mid-September F1 weekend.

faqs.question: Book in advance?
faqs.answer: Premier Sea View rooms 2–3 months ahead. Garden Villas 4–6 months for high season. Sir Manor villa books 9+ months out.

faqs.question: Adults-only?
faqs.answer: No — Capella is family-welcoming and the second pool is family-oriented. The villas and the Auriga Spa wing remain intensely adult.

faqs.question: Best room type?
faqs.answer: Premier Sea View for value. One-Bedroom Garden Villa with private pool for the Singapore-only experience. Sir Manor for multi-generation.

faqs.question: How to get there?
faqs.answer: Changi (SIN) is 35 minutes by Capella Mercedes E-class transfer (S$220). Alternatively, taxi/Grab S$45. The Sentosa cable car from Mount Faber is the scenic option from downtown.
